title: Reveal request
description: Planned (owner decision HR-1, basalt_meta versions 29 and 30). The body of POST /api/v1/approvals/{approvalId}/reveal and POST /api/v1/reverts/{revertId}/reveal, which the approval and revert pages send to the engine that served them, on loopback or inside a Vault link session, under the link's secret, when the person presses Show values. Byte fields are base64url without padding. See CONTRACT.md, Approvals, Rows hidden from the agent.

proof.description:
The reveal proof: a WebAuthn assertion by the person's passkey whose challenge is sha256(utf8("basalt-reveal.1
" + kind + "
" + id + "
" + revealNonce + "
" + hex(sha256(revealKey)) + "
" + rowsHash)), with kind APPROVE or REVERT, id the approvalId or revertId in canonical lowercase form, revealNonce as the request carries it (base64url), revealKey = HKDF-SHA-256(ikm the 16 decoded bytes of revealSecret, salt empty, info "basalt-reveal-key.1", 32 bytes), hex lowercase, and rowsHash the binding's (lowercase hex; a large plan's rowsHash, not its sampleHash). The same fields as an approval response, without approvalId.

revealSecret.description: 16 random bytes the page made for this reveal (crypto.getRandomValues), base64url, 22 characters. Sent only to the engine, never shown; the engine passes Postgres only revealKey, derived from it, and never logs or stores either. Without it a reveal proof is worthless.
